articles.title: Two men injured in Heywood crash on Moss Hall Road
articles.excerpt: Two men were taken to hospital with serious injuries following a crash involving two cars on Moss Hall Road in Heywood.
articles.content_html:
A crash involving two cars occurred on Moss Hall Road in Heywood at around 7.45am on Tuesday, July 28. Two men, aged 35 and 44, were taken to hospital with serious injuries, according to a spokesperson for Greater Manchester Police.

Emergency services, including police and paramedics, attended the scene. An air ambulance also landed nearby. Residents reported that a section of the road was closed for several hours following the incident.

Officers from Greater Manchester Police's Serious Collision Investigation Unit are investigating the crash. They have requested that anyone who witnessed the incident or has relevant footage, such as CCTV or dashcam recordings, come forward with information.

Anyone with information can contact police on 0161 856 4741 or via the Live Chat service, quoting log 616 of 28/07/26. Alternatively, information can be reported anonymously to Crimestoppers at 0800 555 111.

articles.title: Man jailed after armed incident at Heywood school
articles.excerpt: Both Douk Deng has been sentenced after entering Edgar Wood Academy with weapons, prompting a swift police response.
articles.content_html:
A man has been jailed after entering a school in Heywood armed with a hammer, a hatchet and a kitchen knife. Both Douk Deng, a South Sudanese national, was arrested at Edgar Wood Academy after workmen confronted him on the premises.

The incident occurred on July 29, 2026, when staff and students were present. Police responded quickly to the situation, ensuring the safety of those inside the school.

Deng has since been sentenced for his actions, which raised concerns about safety in educational environments. The court proceedings highlighted the seriousness of bringing weapons onto school grounds.

This incident has prompted discussions about security measures in schools, although no immediate changes have been announced. The local community remains vigilant following the event.

articles.title: Roadworks on Birtle Road in Heywood to Begin on 24 August 2026
articles.excerpt: Birtle Road in Heywood will undergo roadworks from 24 to 28 August 2026, resulting in a temporary closure affecting traffic flow.
articles.content_html:
Birtle Road in Heywood will be temporarily closed for roadworks from Monday, 24 August 2026, to Friday, 28 August 2026. The closure will take place daily from 10am to 4pm.

The affected section of Birtle Road will be closed starting at the junction with Gristlehurst Lane and extending 95 metres southward. Due to the nature of the closure, there will be no alternative route for vehicles.

Motorists are advised to plan their journeys accordingly, as the closure may impact traffic flow during the specified hours.

For further details, residents can view a map of roadworks across Greater Manchester on the Rochdale Borough Council website.
